video_title: Why we aren't ready to give Wemby the BEST PLAYER in the world title 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton debate if Victor Wembanyama is the best player in the world
quotes.excerpt: Wemby was the best player in the world. He's still the best player in the world.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: These two guys said Wemby was the best player in the world. He's still the best player in the world.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: No, no, no, no, no, my brother. So Stephen Curry won a unanimous MVP. How did he play in the finals? Not good enough. Jalen Brunson played better.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues that Victor Wembanyama is the best player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: If you're picking a player, who are you picking first? You're picking Wemby.
quotes.quote: If you're picking a player, who are you picking first? You're picking Wemby. There's no one you're picking over him. Everyone is trading Jalen Brunson.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues that other top players have weaknesses that cannot be exploited
quotes.excerpt: Every other best player in the world has spots and you can't speed them up.
quotes.quote: Every other best player in the world has spots and you can't speed them up when we declare who the best player in the world is. Am I wrong? LeBron James has a go-to move, does he not?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson says Victor Wembanyama will learn from his poor performance in the finals
quotes.excerpt: Wemby, you're held to a standard. You played like shit last night.
quotes.quote: Wemby, you're held to a standard. You played like shit last night. You were sped up, you had six turnovers, you were sitting there rushing everything when you did not have to. And he's going to learn from that.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton explains why he cannot crown Victor Wembanyama the best player in the league yet
quotes.excerpt: I can't crown him as the best in the league yet because he still has a lot to learn.
quotes.quote: I can't crown him as the best in the league yet because he still has a lot to learn. He still has a lot of defaults in his game right now. He still has a lot to learn. I can't crown somebody that's not quite there yet.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Charlie Villanueva discuss if the Knicks are better than the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: The team is better, correct? The team is better. Yeah, the team is in.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The team is better, correct? The team is better.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I don't know if the team is better, though. I don't know if the team is better. I just don't think Wemby is the best player.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues Victor Wembanyama is inconsistent on offense
quotes.excerpt: I think he's very inconsistent on offense. Sometimes he scores 35 and sometimes he scores 18.
quotes.quote: I think he's very inconsistent on offense. Sometimes he scores 35 and sometimes he scores 18. His offense consistency and how he dominates on the offensive end is very up and down. I can't have someone that is so inconsistent because of the defense.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson believes the Knicks are the best team in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks are playing the best as a unit because everyone knows their role.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks are playing the best as a unit because everyone knows their role and they perfect it. Josh Hart did absolutely nothing outside of his game. He played the perfect game that Josh Hart needed to play. Karl-Anthony Towns played the perfect way without even, and think about this, this is the thing that makes it dangerous. I don't think this has to do with Wemby being the best. I think the Knicks team is more ready to win a championship right now than the Spurs are.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Victor Wembanyama affects the game on both ends of the floor
quotes.excerpt: The guy affects the game so much on both ends of the floor.
quotes.quote: The guy affects the game so much on both ends of the floor. When you have someone like that, I don't know how you can tell me someone else is better than him.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton says they are crowning Victor Wembanyama based on potential
quotes.excerpt: We're crowning him the best because of what we know he can be.
quotes.quote: We're crowning him the best because of what we know he can be. That's what it is, because we know he's going to be on his potential.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Victor Wembanyama is not getting enough triple-doubles
quotes.excerpt: Wemby is not getting no triple-doubles and shit like that. He's had it once or twice.
quotes.quote: Wemby is not getting no triple-doubles and shit like that. He's had it once or twice.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson maintains that Victor Wembanyama is the best player in the league
quotes.excerpt: I'm not picking no one else other than Wemby. That means that's the best player to me.
quotes.quote: I'm not picking no one else other than Wemby. That means that's the best player to me, to Theo Pinson, not to y'all. I get y'all's opinion. To Theo Pinson, he is the best player in the league because I know he can help my team any fucking night, whether the ball's going in the basket or if it's not going in the basket. I would rather have Victor Wembanyama on my team.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva compares Victor Wembanyama's situation to LeBron James losing to the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I think the crowning of Wemby is no different like when LeBron lost to the Spurs.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think the crowning of Wemby is no different like when LeBron lost to the Spurs in the finals. When they saw that you could literally stop LeBron and himself, nobody was ready to crown him. They still said Kobe was the best because you couldn't do nothing with Kobe. Kobe would find a way to get his shit off.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: But that's the thing, though. I don't determine it just by you winning a championship. If you are the best, you are the best. You might not be the best team. That does not mean.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues that LeBron James was the best player even when he lost
quotes.excerpt: Was LeBron the best player in the world in 2018? It didn't fucking matter.
quotes.quote: Was LeBron the best player in the world in 2018? It didn't fucking matter. He had Kyrie Irving, Steph Curry, Klay Thompson on the other team. Yes, he won. It is a team game. This is not about the best player in the world.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva argues LeBron James was the best player even when he lost
quotes.excerpt: I'm not saying it's because he won in 2018. LeBron was still the best player.
quotes.quote: I'm not saying it's because he won in 2018. LeBron was still the best player when he lost in 18, 17, and 15. But it has to do with Wemby. It's what we saw, how Wemby was stopped, his inconsistencies. That is what we're pointing out.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton says Victor Wembanyama's bad games are different from a regular player's
quotes.excerpt: A bad game for Wemby is totally different than a regular player.
quotes.quote: A bad game for Wemby is totally different than a regular player. Like Wemby played, if you want to look at his stats, number wise, shit was good. Jalen Brunson was 12 for 30. He made the biggest shots at the end of the game.
